action: PowerDNS advises upgrading to a patched version (4.9.19, 5.0.9 or 5.1.6); the advisory also lists per-issue workarounds such as not using catalog zones or restricting access to the internal webserver.
date_note: The oss-security post carrying the advisory is dated 26 November; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: PowerDNS published an advisory for multiple issues in Authoritative Server; the vendor says patched versions are available.
geo_basis: approximate vendor country; the advisory page read does not state a location
plain: PowerDNS has published security fixes for several flaws in its Authoritative Server DNS software. No exploitation is mentioned in the advisory text read.
summary: PowerDNS published Security Advisory 2026-14 covering multiple issues in PowerDNS Authoritative Server, each with its own CVE. The advisory says they are fixed in versions 4.9.19, 5.0.9 and 5.1.6, with the LMDB backend issue fixed only in 5.1.6 and the Views issue in 5.0.9 and 5.1.6. For most issues it lists workarounds such as not using catalog zones or restricting webserver access; for the TSIG issue it lists none.
title: PowerDNS publishes advisory 2026-14: multiple issues fixed in Authoritative Server 4.9.19, 5.0.9 and 5.1.6

validation.note: Only the vendor advisory as posted to oss-security was read; the BSI CERT-Bund notice (WID-SEC-2026-4826) returned no content.

review.note: 10 CVEs, fixed versions, workarounds, TSIG none, no exploitation statement against oss-security advisory
